correctness.rationale: All quantifiers n≥2 and real s≥0 are explicit. Full cited Proposition 5.1 gives the complete distinct corner/strip vertex types. Their exact squared Frobenius norms are 1/(ab) and 1/n; a weighted count yields the moment identity and factorized conditional tilt law. Harmonic integral comparisons prove macroscopic, logarithmic and zeta limits, including the s=1+λ/log n window. Continuous mapping gives the (UV)^−1 heavy tail and moment nonuniformity. The bundled exact checker validates 496 explicit vertices, all inequalities, and 40 exact moments; finite checks are not offered as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Squared Frobenius norm of an entry-normalized nonnegative matrix is a natural collision probability. Integer powers correspond to independently observed repeated collisions, so the bias family is intrinsic rather than arbitrarily selected. The exact moment spectrum identifies the sharp moment-divergence threshold, an explicit two-dimensional product-Pareto law, and a logarithmic scale where localization changes from macroscopic to atomic. The critical finite-size window explains this sharp transition across an infinite natural polytope family, beyond a simple finite enumeration.
